verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and therefore removes rows/columns `768..895` from each projection instead of head 5's rows/columns `640..767`. The kept index becomes `0..767, 896..2047`, which contradicts required-result clauses 1–4, all of which specify keeping `0..639` then `768..2047`. The shape assertions still pass (`[1920, 2048]` for q/k/v, `[2048, 1920]` for o_proj), so the required checks cannot catch the error — they constrain only shapes, not which block was dropped. Grading is bit-exact against a hidden reference, so every one of the 64 head-bearing tensors would mismatch. The module docstring confirms this is not a typo in a single constant but a consistent misreading of the target head.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
